note: FNS Section 724 provides review procedures for states that use a mixed budgeting system — where some income elements are budgeted prospectively while others are budgeted retrospectively within the same case. Massachusetts uses prospective budgeting for all SNAP income elements. The OLG covers Simplified Reporting and Change Reporting certification types, both of which use prospective budgeting (anticipating income for the upcoming period). There is no mention of retrospective budgeting or monthly reporting anywhere in the OLG's SNAP content. Since Massachusetts does not operate a mixed prospective/retrospective budgeting system, this FNS section's procedures do not apply to Massachusetts SNAP cases.
